sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Sergey Arsenyevich Samoylov, known by his alias "Mechanic", is a trader in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text:
A former chemical plant foreman, who from the very beginning of the conflict took to weapon modification, repairs, and maintenance of complex equipment and technology. He prefers clandestine solo living and operates discreetly, while placing complicated and challenging tasks above all else.

Despite the difficult situation in the region, he retained access to the "mainland" via the Internet and satellite communications. He has accounts in foreign banks, and, if desired, he could easily get out of Tarkov.

Everyone in the city trusts him, even Scavs perceive him as a useful person who can help with establishing network communications in the conditions of complete destruction and blockade of the city. His main motivation for being in the region is his favorite craft.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Mechanic is initially locked, and can be unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.
